briefing.text: Information Technology leads all three platforms: buzz 95.2 on Reddit (+1.0 on the day, mentions +123%, sentiment -0.02; NVDA, AMD, AAPL, MSFT, INTC), 93.3 on X (-0.3, mentions -5%, sentiment 0.12; NVDA, AMD, CRWV, MU, MSFT) and 87.8 on News (-0.5, mentions +28%, sentiment 0.04). On News, Financials jumped from rank 6 to 2 (buzz 86.6, +4.8 on the day, +11.0 over the week; BAC, UBS, MS, JEF, C). Reddit buzz fell most in Utilities (68.7, -6.7 on the day, -8.5 over the week, mentions -52%; VST, BEP), while on X the small Technology group rose 8.6 on a 250% mentions jump (DRK) and Financial Services gained 5.1 (sentiment 0.32; FRNM, PAXG). Health Care on News is steady at rank 4 (buzz 85.1, +1.1, mentions +44%; LLY, MRNA, JNJ).

NVDA #1: futures were mixed ahead of an inflation report after a volatile session marked by Nvidia's leadership shake-up; 1,756 articles in two days, more negative (452) than positive (158). It fits the high attention, with earnings on 11-17 as catalyst.
KDP #2: shares slipped about 1.1% premarket after pricing a $2 billion share offering. That explains the large price move (3.4 sigma) behind its jump from #9.
TTWO #3: Q2 earnings call highlights, with GTA VI pre-orders and a story about a firm giving 7,000 staff a day off to play GTA 6. This explains the attention.
GOLD #4: only 4 articles, and the one shown is a Bitcoin investment-return piece; the news does not explain the rank.
KLAR #5: Klarna named Chris Koegel, a Robinhood veteran, as CFO; with earnings on 11-17 and a 2.4 sigma move, it partly explains the new entry.
UST30Y #6: reports that Treasury Secretary Bessent moved to a military base over Iranian threats; the FOMC on Dec 9 is the stated catalyst, so the news only loosely explains the rank.
GPUCOMPUTE #7: Nvidia board and Jensen Huang resignation commentary; it shares NVDA's attention numbers, so the news explains it.
CRWV #9: reports that Cathie Wood bought about $16M of CRWV and retail is buying the Nvidia dip; moderate support for the rank.

NVDA ranks first on attention: Reddit, X and News mentions are 2.0 log units above its own 19-day normal (99.5th percentile), and trading volume so far today is well above normal (1.64, top percentile), with earnings on 11-17. KDP rose from #9 to #2 mostly on a 3.4-sigma price move and above-normal volume (0.81), while its attention is only moderate (0.76 overall, 0.26 on X). TTWO holds #3 on balanced attention (0.79 overall, 0.78 on X) with a small price move (0.6 sigma) and low volume (0.14); no catalyst is listed. The score weights attention and X attention at 35% each, so these two inputs drive most of the ordering.

notes: Ranks are by the scoring of record (pick_rank, w2). Prices and moves as of the last pull of the day. Facts from public data; not investment advice.
